channel.title: saltLight
channel.description: Releases of saltLight by Moonlabor B.V.

item.title: saltLight 0.2.0
item.description:
• A new left side: what plays now, then the queue. Press ▶ to play a scene, Next for the next one, and choose how long the crossfade takes.
  • New scene at the bottom left; Reset and Save at the bottom right. saltLight names each scene for you.
  • The scene panel on the right rests until you pick a scene in the queue, or make a new one.
  • Two sites: ASOP and AJ's Kitchen. Open the pill at the top right to switch. Each site has its own queue and its own Bridge.
  • Live plays what plays now on the site you are on. In AJ's Kitchen it streams to the kitchen strip, and the four ceiling spots follow its brightness and warmth.
  • The window fits a smaller screen too, down to an iPad's width.

item.title: saltLight 0.3.0
item.description:
• Presets under the queue: each site's own three, added to the queue with +. Omakase is yours to shape once.
  • Every card in the queue and the presets plays its scene, as the room does.
  • Add scene sits after the last scene in the queue; on the right, Send to cue and Reset.
  • Preview and Live switch what the middle shows; On the lights, beside Hold and Next, drives the room and hands it back.
  • The site pill works like saltFrame's library: each site with its place, the current one ticked.
  • One ring at the top shows what saltLight is doing: finding, pairing, reading, going on the lights, handing back.
  • Map the lights: tap a strip on the plan and pick which Hue light it is.
  • When saltLight loses its engine, the left side dims and says so, with Try again.
  • Keys: press ? to see them. ⌘Z undoes the last change to the queue.
  • The lights always go back to Hue when saltLight quits, sleeps or stops unexpectedly.
